Module com.example.cab302_project
Package com.app.studysnap.services

Class QuizService

java.lang.Object
com.app.studysnap.services.QuizService
public final class QuizService extends Object
API quiz generator that produces five-option MCQs (A–E) with optional answer lines.

Sources supported:

  • Uploaded file (PDF/TXT) – parsed to text then summarized into MCQs.
  • Raw pasted text – summarized into MCQs.
  • Freeform topic prompt – generated MCQs around a topic.
Default provider: Google Gemini (gemini-2.0-flash). The expected output format per question is: 
 1. Question text
 A) ...
 B) ...
 C) ...
 D) ...
 E) ...
 Answer: A
